before.question: At scoring, does the base basic-servant objective include a butler, housekeeper or underbutler, and how does this differ from normal service VP and the ten-servant objective?
before.expected_answer: The base basic-servant objective gives one VP per common footman, valet or lady’s maid, excluding butler, housekeeper and underbutler. Normal service VP counts every servant at two VP each; the ten-servant objective counts all servants in employ and gives seven VP.
